title: Hinesol attenuates DSS-induced ulcerative colitis through the suppression of Src-mediated NF-kappaB and chemokine signaling pathway.
authors: Li, Yun-Xia; Liu, Jinzhong; Li, Fang
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药成分Hinesol通过抑制Src介导的NF-kB和趋化因子信号通路缓解溃疡性结肠炎，属于炎症与信号通路湿实验研究，无蛋白质-DNA互作、无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: As a common inflammatory bowel disease, ulcerative colitis (UC) is featured with inflammation, oxidative damage, and the impairment of intestinal mucosal barrier, which bring threat to patients' quality of live. Hinesol, derived from Atractylodes lancea, is a unique sesquiterpenoid. Our study proposed to survey the effects and mechanism of hinesol in UC. UC mouse model was constructed using dextran sulfate sodium (DSS). Lipopolysaccharide (LPS) was applied for RAW264.7 cells stimulation to construct cell inflammatory model. The changes of disease activity index (DAI), body weight, colon length, and intestinal pathology in mice were analyzed to estimate the severity of colitis. Enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay was applied to check the changes of interleukin (IL)-1beta, IL-18, IL-6, and tumor necrosis factor (TNF)-alpha. The levels of myeloperoxidase (MPO), superoxide dismutase (SOD), glutathione peroxidase (GSH-px), catalase (CAT), and malondialdehyde (MDA) were estimated by corresponding reagent kit. The changes of phosphorylated (p)-NF-kappaB P65, and p-IkappaBalpha, ZO-1, Occludin, Claudin-1, Src, XCL1, CCL2, and CXCL16 protein were examined using western blot. Flow cytometry and cell counting kit-8 assay were utilized for assessment of cell apoptosis and viability. We found that DSS reduced mice body weight, increased DAI, shorten colon length, and led to severe enteric mucosal injury, while hinesol improved the above symptoms induced by DSS. In DSS mice, hinesol raised the levels of ZO-1, Occludin, Claudin-1, SOD, GSH-px, and CAT and decreased the levels of TNF-alpha, IL-18, IL-1beta, IL-6, MPO, and MDA. Additionally, in DSS mice and LPS-stimulated RAW264.7 cells, hinesol inhibited the high expression of Src, XCL1, CCL2, CXCL16, p-NF-kappaB P65, and p-IkappaBalpha. The molecular docking showed that there was a good interaction between hinesol and Src. Moreover, in LPS-stimulated RAW 264.7 cells, Src overexpression partially reversed the inhibition of hinesol on cell apoptosis, pro-inflammatory factors, and oxidative stress. In conclusion, hinesol alleviated DSS-induced colitis, which might have a bearing on the inhibition of Src-mediated NF-kappaB and chemokine signaling pathway.
abstract_zh: 作为一种常见的炎症性肠病，溃疡性结肠炎（ulcerative colitis, UC）以炎症、氧化损伤及肠黏膜屏障受损为特征，对患者生活质量构成威胁。茅苍术醇（Hinesol）源自苍术（Atractylodes lancea），是一种独特的倍半萜类化合物。本研究旨在探讨茅苍术醇在UC中的作用及机制。采用葡聚糖硫酸钠（dextran sulfate sodium, DSS）构建UC小鼠模型，脂多糖（lipopolysaccharide, LPS）刺激RAW264.7细胞构建细胞炎症模型。分析小鼠疾病活动指数（disease activity index, DAI）、体重、结肠长度及肠道病理变化以评估结肠炎严重程度。采用酶联免疫吸附试验检测白细胞介素（interleukin, IL）-1β、IL-18、IL-6及肿瘤坏死因子（tumor necrosis factor, TNF）-α的变化。通过相应试剂盒评估髓过氧化物酶（myeloperoxidase, MPO）、超氧化物歧化酶（superoxide dismutase, SOD）、谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶（glutathione peroxidase, GSH-px）、过氧化氢酶（catalase, CAT）及丙二醛（malondialdehyde, MDA）水平。利用Western blot检测磷酸化（phosphorylated, p）-NF-κB P65、p-IκBα、ZO-1、Occludin、Claudin-1、Src、XCL1、CCL2及CXCL16蛋白的变化。采用流式细胞术和细胞计数试剂盒-8（cell counting kit-8）评估细胞凋亡和活力。结果显示，DSS降低小鼠体重、增加DAI、缩短结肠长度并导致严重肠黏膜损伤，而茅苍术醇改善了DSS诱导的上述症状。在DSS小鼠中，茅苍术醇提高了ZO-1、Occludin、Claudin-1、SOD、GSH-px及CAT水平，并降低了TNF-α、IL-18、IL-1β、IL-6、MPO及MDA水平。此外，在DSS小鼠和LPS刺激的RAW264.7细胞中，茅苍术醇抑制了Src、XCL1、CCL2、CXCL16、p-NF-κB P65及p-IκBα的高表达。分子对接显示茅苍术醇与Src之间存在良好相互作用。进一步在LPS刺激的RAW264.7细胞中，Src过表达部分逆转了茅苍术醇对细胞凋亡、促炎因子及氧化应激的抑制作用。总之，茅苍术醇缓解了DSS诱导的结肠炎，这可能与其抑制Src介导的NF-κB及趋化因子信号通路有关。
